project.name: VoyagerM
project.summary: A local-first Flutter learning app for roadmaps, saved learning materials, study notes, and supported YouTube/MIT OpenCourseWare playback.
project.architectureNote: No backend service or REST API is inferred; storage and playback boundaries are local repositories and platform media integrations.
project.evidencePolicy: Source imports, declarations, repository registrations, platform channels, and schema statements are source-backed. Curated workflows are marked partial where source wiring is incomplete.

components.name: Startup & dependency wiring
components.summary: Initializes Flutter, registers app services, loads settings, and creates the root app shell.
components.developerSummary: The composition root configures GetIt, resolves initial settings, and constructs VoyagerApp/AppShell.

components.name: Home & navigation
components.summary: Hosts the main tabs and opens the app’s library, history, progress, bookmarks, profile, and player flows.
components.developerSummary: AppShell owns tab selection and routes secondary screens through Navigator/MaterialPageRoute.

components.name: Roadmaps
components.summary: Creates and edits roadmaps and their learning topics through a repository contract.
components.developerSummary: RoadmapsPage uses RoadmapRepository for roadmap/topic CRUD and completion confirmation.

components.name: Learning library
components.summary: Stores saved videos and playlists and opens playlist entries in the learning player.
components.developerSummary: The library contract has SQLite and in-memory implementations; screens save and resolve content through it.

components.name: Study notes
components.summary: Creates, edits, organizes, and retrieves local study notes, including timestamped notes and embedded images.
components.developerSummary: NotesRepository is used by NotesHomePage, NoteEditorPage, and the player; images are stored as local files on IO platforms and inline data URLs in Web notes.
notes: Image embeds are implemented: IO platforms save image files under the application documents directory; Web stores image data URLs with browser-local notes.
This does not imply support for arbitrary file attachments.

components.name: Progress & bookmarks
components.summary: Saves playback progress and completion and lists or removes saved playback moments.
components.developerSummary: ProgressRepository has SQLite/in-memory implementations; player writes progress, but no active player call creates bookmarks.
notes: Bookmark listing/deletion is wired in the home shell; no saveBookmark call is present in the current player screen.

components.name: Recent watch history
components.summary: Records recently loaded lessons and presents the recent list from Home.
components.developerSummary: RecentWatchHistoryRepository is injected into the player and read by the home history page.

components.name: Daily goals
components.summary: Tracks today’s eligible playback time and manually completed lessons against local goals.
components.developerSummary: DailyGoalRepository is registered centrally, updated by player activity/completion, and read by Home/Settings.

components.name: Watch activity & streaks
components.summary: Accumulates eligible watch time by local date and calculates streaks and activity summaries.
components.developerSummary: WatchActivityTracker consumes player snapshots; repositories persist date-keyed totals and WatchStreakCalculator derives streaks.

components.name: Local profile
components.summary: Stores a local display name and username and shows watch activity; there is no cloud account.
components.developerSummary: ProfilePage composes LocalProfileRepository with WatchActivityRepository and WatchStreakCalculator.

components.name: Settings
components.summary: Persists appearance, playback, resume, completion-confirmation, and daily-goal preferences locally.
components.developerSummary: SettingsRepository is loaded before runApp and updated by the settings screen through VoyagerApp.

components.name: Learning player
components.summary: Connects lesson loading, playback controls, note saving, history, progress, and eligible watch-time tracking.
components.developerSummary: LearningPlayerScreen is the UI boundary around PlaybackController and injected repository contracts.

components.name: Media source & playback
components.summary: Recognizes supported links, resolves YouTube/OCW content, selects streams, and drives the platform player.
components.developerSummary: DefaultPlaybackController composes SourceDetector, VideoSourceRegistry, adapters, StreamSelectionPolicy, cache, and MediaPlayer.

components.name: SQLite & persistence
components.summary: Provides the app-owned database contract and SQLite schema/migrations used by local repositories.
components.developerSummary: AppDatabase abstracts sqflite; SqfliteAppDatabase owns schema version 7, migrations, indexes, and transactions.

components.name: Design system
components.summary: Defines shared colors, typography, themes, reusable controls, and a debug showcase.
components.developerSummary: DesignTokens feeds AppTheme and shared controls; DesignSystemShowcase is opened only in debug builds.

components.name: Shared links
components.summary: Parses incoming shared YouTube links and bridges Android share intents into Flutter.
components.developerSummary: SharedYoutubeLink validates supported links; AndroidSharedVideoIntentSource consumes the EventChannel contract.

components.name: App configuration
components.summary: Reads build-time configuration used to enable or disable supported media extraction.
components.developerSummary: AppConfig reads compile-time environment values; it does not define a server or cloud configuration.

components.name: Android platform
components.summary: Implements native Media3 playback, NewPipe extraction, platform channels, and incoming share intents.
components.developerSummary: MainActivity registers player/extractor/share channels and a platform view; Gradle adds Media3 and NewPipe.

components.name: Web preview
components.summary: Provides Flutter Web bootstrap assets; repository selection uses in-memory stores on Web by default.
components.developerSummary: Web is a Flutter target; this directory does not contain a separate backend or custom web API.

components.name: Automated tests
components.summary: Exercises repository behavior, media rules, app flows, and selected widgets with controlled inputs.
components.developerSummary: Flutter tests use fakes/in-memory repositories; live provider extraction and Android device playback are not established by these tests.

components.name: Project configuration & docs
components.summary: Holds package/platform build configuration and explanatory documents; docs can lag behind active source.
components.developerSummary: Includes pubspec/analyzer configuration, platform build files, and project documentation. Documentation is not treated as proof of execution.
notes: docs/development-roadmap.md conflicts with currently wired progress/settings flows; source and tests are treated as authoritative.

workflows.name: Application startup
workflows.summary: Flutter initializes, repositories and media services are registered, saved settings are loaded, and the app shell is shown.

steps.title: Initialize Flutter
steps.simple: Prepare Flutter before the app uses plugins.
steps.developer: main() calls WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized().

steps.title: Register services
steps.simple: Choose app storage and create the media services the screens will use.
steps.developer: configureDependencies() registers in-memory or SQLite repositories and a PlaybackController factory in GetIt.

steps.title: Load settings
steps.simple: Read the saved appearance and playback preferences.
steps.developer: main() resolves SettingsRepository and awaits getSettings() before runApp.

steps.title: Build the UI
steps.simple: Show VoyagerApp and its main navigation shell.
steps.developer: VoyagerApp builds MaterialApp and AppShell with the selected settings and repositories.

workflows.name: Select local storage
workflows.summary: The composition root chooses in-memory repositories for Web/mock mode and SQLite otherwise.

steps.title: Choose mode
steps.simple: Web uses temporary in-memory data by default; tests can request the same mode.
steps.developer: shouldUseMocks is useMocks ?? kIsWeb; this is not a blanket “all non-Android is Web” check.

steps.title: Register store implementations
steps.simple: The app connects each repository contract to an in-memory or SQLite implementation.
steps.developer: GetIt registrations pair feature repository interfaces with implementations; SQLite initialization is skipped in mock mode.

steps.title: Initialize SQLite when selected
steps.simple: The SQLite branch opens the versioned local database.
steps.developer: SqfliteAppDatabase.initialize() opens the v7 database with foreign keys enabled and upgrade callbacks.

workflows.name: Open roadmaps
workflows.summary: The main shell shows RoadmapsPage with the roadmap repository selected during app setup.

steps.title: Select Roadmaps
steps.simple: Choose the Roadmaps tab in the main navigation.
steps.developer: AppShell selects RoadmapsPage in the tab list and passes its repository and completion setting.

steps.title: Read or update topics
steps.simple: The page loads roadmaps and saves topic changes through its repository.
steps.developer: RoadmapsPage calls RoadmapRepository; it does not issue SQLite queries directly.

steps.title: Persist through the selected implementation
steps.simple: The selected repository stores changes in memory or SQLite.
steps.developer: The composition root registers InMemoryRoadmapRepository or SqliteRoadmapRepository backed by AppDatabase.

workflows.name: Save a playlist
workflows.summary: The player resolves playlist metadata and entries, then saves them via the learning-library contract.

steps.title: Load playlist source
steps.simple: Paste or open a supported playlist link in the player.
steps.developer: LearningPlayerScreen delegates source loading to PlaybackController and handles PlaylistInfo.

steps.title: Resolve entries
steps.simple: The selected adapter turns the provider response into app-owned playlist and video models.
steps.developer: The source registry selects an adapter; platform-specific extraction is hidden behind VideoSourceAdapter.

steps.title: Save library records
steps.simple: The player writes the playlist, its videos, and their order through the library repository.
steps.developer: The player calls LearningLibraryRepository methods; the selected implementation stores the playlist and ordered entries.

workflows.name: Load and play a lesson
workflows.summary: A supported YouTube or MIT OCW URL is identified, resolved, converted into a selected stream, and sent to a platform player.

steps.title: Accept a supported link
steps.simple: The player checks the pasted link and recognizes supported YouTube or MIT OCW sources.
steps.developer: LearningPlayerScreen calls DefaultPlaybackController; SourceDetector validates the URL and produces a SourceDescriptor.

steps.title: Select a provider adapter
steps.simple: The registry chooses the adapter that understands this source.
steps.developer: VideoSourceRegistry selects NewPipeYoutubeAdapter or MitOcwAdapter through VideoSourceAdapter.

steps.title: Choose a playable stream
steps.simple: The app picks a supported stream with the required audio/video tracks.
steps.developer: StreamSelectionPolicy filters supported MIME types/resolution and PlaybackController requests stream replacement when needed.

steps.title: Start platform playback
steps.simple: Android uses the native Media3 player; other configured targets use video_player.
steps.developer: service_locator selects AndroidMediaPlayer only for Android outside mock mode; otherwise it creates FlutterMediaPlayer.

steps.title: Record stable learning activity
steps.simple: The player records loaded-video history and eligible playback totals, not temporary media URLs.
steps.developer: LearningPlayerScreen writes RecentWatchHistoryRepository and WatchActivityTracker data; metadata cache keeps stable details.

workflows.name: Save a timestamped note
workflows.summary: A player note is linked to the active video and playback position, then written through NotesRepository.

steps.title: Capture the current lesson
steps.simple: The note editor receives the active video and the current playback time.
steps.developer: LearningPlayerScreen prepares a StudyNote with videoId and timestampSeconds.

steps.title: Save through the note contract
steps.simple: The player asks NotesRepository to save the note.
steps.developer: The player calls NotesRepository; it does not write SQL directly.

steps.title: Persist locally
steps.simple: The selected notes store saves the note on device or in the current in-memory store.
steps.developer: DI selects SQLite, in-memory, or browser-backed note storage according to platform/mode.

workflows.name: Insert an image in a note
workflows.summary: The note editor embeds a picked image; storage differs between IO platforms and Web.

steps.title: Choose an image
steps.simple: The note editor opens the system image picker.
steps.developer: NoteEditorPage._insertImage() asks NoteImageStore to pick an image from the gallery.

steps.title: Store for the current platform
steps.simple: Web embeds the image data in the note; other IO platforms write a file in app documents.
steps.developer: NoteImageStore returns a data URL for Web and delegates to the IO implementation, which writes under notes/images and returns that local path.

steps.title: Save the note and its image reference
steps.simple: The note repository stores the editor document locally; unused IO image files are cleaned after note changes.
steps.developer: The note Delta is saved through NotesRepository. IO cleanup retains referenced file paths and deletes unreferenced files; Web data URLs are stored with browser-backed notes.

workflows.name: Save playback progress
workflows.summary: The player saves the current position and completion state, and Home can reopen an incomplete lesson.

steps.title: Observe lesson position
steps.simple: The player reads the playback position while the lesson is open.
steps.developer: LearningPlayerScreen calls PlaybackController.currentPosition and saves LearningProgress during activity flush/cleanup.

steps.title: Store progress through its contract
steps.simple: The progress repository saves the position and completion state.
steps.developer: ProgressRepository abstracts SQLite and in-memory stores; metadata is stored so progress has a stable video record.

steps.title: Resume from Home
steps.simple: Home opens the saved position without starting playback automatically.
steps.developer: AppShell resolves the latest incomplete LearningProgress and opens LearningPlayerScreen with initialPosition.

workflows.name: Browse bookmarks (creation is not wired)
workflows.summary: The app can list, open, and delete existing bookmarks; the current player has no active call that creates one.

steps.title: Read bookmark records
steps.simple: The Home bookmark page reads saved moments from ProgressRepository.
steps.developer: AppShell._BookmarksPageState queries getAllBookmarks and joins each record with library video metadata.

steps.title: Open or delete a moment
steps.simple: Selecting a record reopens its saved time; the delete action removes it.
steps.developer: The screen passes initialPosition to the player and calls deleteBookmark; no saveBookmark call is wired in the current player.

implementationNotes.title: Bookmark creation is not wired in the player
implementationNotes.explanation: Current source lists, opens, and deletes bookmarks, but no player call creates them.

implementationNotes.title: Development roadmap has stale status claims
implementationNotes.explanation: It still says settings and progress are not saved/connected, while current source wires settings persistence and playback progress.

implementationNotes.title: Note image embeds are missing from the implementation status
implementationNotes.explanation: The note editor can insert images. IO platforms store image files under app documents; Web embeds data URLs with browser-local notes. This does not establish arbitrary file attachment support.

implementationNotes.title: Provider availability is not established by unit tests
implementationNotes.explanation: Controlled tests do not guarantee live YouTube/OCW extraction or device playback will keep working.
